name: motion-exit-faster
title: Exit Faster than Enter
description: Bài học: cảnh thoát chỉ dài 65–75 % cảnh vào; vào thì ease-out, ra thì ease-in.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: A block enters 210 px in 300 ms expo.out, holds, then exits 240 px in 210 ms expo.in. Rule: exits last 65–75 % of the entrance; entrance ease-out, exit ease-in; what leaves should not hold attention. Params: in (0.3 s ease-out) · out (0.21 s ease-in). What leaves should not hold attention.
